jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Config, AWS Config
jobs.description: AWS Config is the service that lets customers assess, audit, and evaluate the configurations of their AWS resources at scale. Config continuously records resource configuration changes and relationships across accounts and regions, and powers compliance, security, and governance for millions of customers. We're investing heavily in the next generation of the service — from the ingestion and recording backend to the customer-facing console experience — and we're looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build it. This is a full-stack role. You'll work across the stack: designing and building resilient, high-throughput backend APIs and data pipelines that record and process configuration data, and building the console and UI experiences that customers use to explore their resources, relationships, and compliance posture. You'll have opportunities to setup new services and deliver features to existing services — from design docs and API contracts through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. You'll join a team that values operational excellence, thoughtful design, and mentorship. You'll partner with senior engineers, principal engineers, product managers, and other AWS service teams to have direct impact on how customers understand and secure their cloud footprint. Key job responsibilities - Design, build, and operate scalable backend services and APIs that record, process, and serve AWS resource configuration data. - Build customer-facing console and web experiences, translating customer needs into intuitive, performant, and accessible UI. - Write high-quality, well-tested code across the stack, and contribute to design and code reviews. - Own the operational health of your services, participate in on-call, monitor with metrics and alarms, and drive down operational load through automation. - Leverage AI to efficiently and effectively execute your job - Collaborate with senior engineers and principal engineers on architecture and technical direction, and help raise the bar through mentorship and design feedback. A day in the life You might start the day refining an API contract with a partner team, move into implementing a new console view backed by that API, review a teammate's CR, and wrap up by cutting an alarm-driven improvement to reduce recurring on-call noise. You'll balance new feature delivery with the operational excellence that keeps a AWS service healthy. About the team The AWS Config Storage and Delivery team owns configuration owns storage and delivery of Config data. Our work spans storage and delivery of data that customers rely on for compliance and governance. We care deeply about each team member and respect their opinions. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Agentic Workspaces
jobs.description: As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use. Amazon WorkSpaces has protected and empowered enterprise work for over a decade, and we are now reimagining what a workspace is. We are building Agentic WorkSpaces: a platform where the workspace itself is an active partner in how you work, not just infrastructure that delivers applications. Today more than a million users rely on WorkSpaces daily; tomorrow those workspaces will host AI agents alongside humans, agents that code, troubleshoot, analyze, and act on behalf of their users, governed by the same identity and security policies as the people they serve. We compete with Microsoft, Citrix, and Omnissa, and we intend to leapfrog them by building the workspace that was designed for the agentic era, not retrofitted for it. Agentic WorkSpaces' Data Plane is the connective tissue that makes this possible: the single entry point through which every WorkSpaces connection flows, and the streaming backbone that delivers the desktop experience once a session begins. We own the end-to-end pre-session journey, authentication across every identity method, session authorization, resource discovery, gateway selection, and cross-region failover, as well as the in-session streaming stack that carries pixels to the user and the pipeline that delivers workspace health and performance metrics back to our customers. Our vision is for that connection to be seamless and invisible: users and the agents working beside them reach their workspace instantly and securely, sessions stream with high fidelity and low latency, failover is transparent, and the health of every connection is observable through the same AWS tools customers already use, delivered reliably from commercial regions to classified partitions, at a scale where availability and security are non-negotiable. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to design, build, and operate the services that authenticate, authorize, connect, and stream WorkSpaces sessions for humans and, increasingly, for the AI agents that work beside them, across every supported identity provider and streaming protocol. You will own end-to-end delivery of features and systems within the Data Plane, from design through deployment and operations, holding a high bar for availability, latency, and security on the services that stand between every customer and their workspace. You are customer-obsessed, technically deep, and energized by solving hard problems. You think big about what the workspace of the future looks like, a connection fabric that treats humans and agents as first-class principals, streaming that adapts intelligently to network conditions, and brokering that routes and heals itself before users notice a problem, and then you build the systems to get there. You thrive in ambiguity, make sound trade-off decisions with incomplete information, and hold yourself accountable for results that matter. You want to solve challenging problems in distributed systems, identity, real-time streaming, and network infrastructure at a scale that impacts more than a million users daily. Key job responsibilities Design and deliver features and systems within the Data Plane, contributing to the architecture strategy for how the connection and streaming layer evolves to broker and stream sessions for AI agents alongside human users. Drive the work that unifies and simplifies how sessions are brokered and streamed across protocols, making a consistent, high-fidelity connection experience the default. Partner with compute, identity providers, networking, and gateway teams, earning trust by driving technical discussions that result in impactful architectural decisions. Design and implement pre-session authentication, authorization, and governance for a world where humans and agents share the same connection path: identity integration across every authentication method, session authorization and access policies that treat agents as first-class principals, and a security posture built in rather than bolted on. Own the operation of low-latency, high-availability brokering and streaming services that are the single entry point for more than one million WorkSpaces users globally. Ensure your services meet stringent SLAs across multiple production regions, AWS partitions, and streaming protocols, with self-healing routing, transparent cross-region failover, and autonomous issue resolution before customers are impacted. Drive engineering excellence through instrumentation, automated testing, and pipeline-based deployment, eliminating manual toil and delivering a consistent connection and streaming experience across every protocol. Think big about the agentic era and experiment boldly with AI-powered capabilities such as intelligent gateway selection, self-diagnosing connections, and AI-assisted operational management. Raise the bar on connection reliability and observability so that authentication, session brokering, high-fidelity streaming, and customer-facing metrics are delivered without imposing an operational tax on the customer or the agent workflows running on the desktop. About the team ABOUT AWS: Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Quick
jobs.description: Do you like building software from ground up? Do you want to revolutionize the way people manage, visualize and interact with large amounts of data? Come and join the AWS Database Services and Analytics team – the creators of Amazon QuickSight, Aurora, DynamoDB, Redshift, and Relational Database (RDS) services. We are always building something new and improving something we have built. Most recently, we launched Amazon Quick, a very fast, cloud-powered AI and business analytics service that makes it easy for everyone – regardless of their technical skill – to build visualizations, perform ad-hoc analysis and quickly get business insights from their data. As more data is being generated in the cloud and tens of thousands of customers migrating their on-premises data into the AWS cloud, Amazon QuickSight is positioned to change the business analytics. Regardless of whether the data is in Files (desktop or S3), SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MariaDB), AWS data stores (Athena, RDS, RedShift, Aurora), or SaaS business applications (Salesforce), Amazon QuickSight makes it easy for our customers analyze and get insights instantly. Our mission is to devise new, innovative ways to simplify data management and analysis and get insights fast, and let our customers focus more on running their business using those insights, and not worry about infrastructure management. In Amazon Web Services (AWS), our mission is to provide customers with best in class data services in the cloud to store, query and analyze the enormous data sets that their businesses generate. We build distributed storage, index and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage and use. These are exciting times in our space – we are growing fast, but still at an early stage and working on ambitious new initiatives where an engineer at any level can have significant technical and business impact. Our team pioneered Amazon RDS, Amazon DynamoDB, and Amazon Redshift. Each service changed the course of database history by bringing new and innovative features to our customers.
